scenes.scene: Sam and the user discuss which movie to see on Saturday. They choose The Last Lantern, and Sam buys two tickets for seats F11 and F12 at the Rialto's 7:30pm showing. Sam confirms the purchase in the conversation.
scenes.test_intent: Later, ask about the purchased movie tickets. A complete answer must name the movie, identify the theater and showing time, and give both purchased seat numbers. Judge the movie, theater, time, and each seat independently.
